title: Core 12-Woman #47
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, twelve women in a single row.

A photograph of TWELVE women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 12 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render. Exactly 12 women, no more, no fewer.

Left to right:
[Yoruba bridal / Black Glamour]: Yoruba Nigerian woman, early 40s, cheerful, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, stiletto nails (holographic). a shockingly extreme waist-to-hip contrast — a colossal bust, an extremely narrow cinched waist, hips flaring to many times that width. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Piercings: 8pc drop dangles/pearls/brass/sym. Jewellery: four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold a bracelet. Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body. [guofeng / Heavy Muscle]: Chinese woman, late 40s, demure and soft, porcelain-pale skin, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, a serene expression, soft rose-gold hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, coffin nails (chrome). massive thick arms, broad muscular back, huge chest, dense muscular torso and legs with only a soft hint of a waist. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large. Exactly 12 women total.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 12, catching each woman's own painted pattern and piercings distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
